buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses REMOTE OPERATION OF PK2000 VSC HVDC STATIONS (PUGALUR & T HRISSUR) FROM

NTAMC Scope of Work (under contractor’s scope unless stated otherwise) 1. This objective of the work is to enable the remote operation of Pugalur & Thr issur HVDC stations from NTAMC. All the control & monitoring capabilities av ailable at the local HMI (of PK2000) shall be available for the remote HMI(s) a t NTAMC. The remote HMI shall be a replica of the local HMI. 2. The contractor has to supply the materials/equipment’s required for remote operation as per BOQ. 3. Under POWERGRID scope: · Allow for utilization of existing HMI workstation including existing softw are licenses as installed in above said HMI. · Transportation of the said HMI from Pugalur HVDC station to NTAMC. · Providing redundant communication link from both Pugalur and Thrissu r HVDC terminals to NTAMC Manesar. · Arrangement of entrance pass, shutdown & permit to work (PTW). 4. The contractor has to carry out · Supply of 3 new HMI’s at NTAMC out of which one HMI needs to be utilized for configuring remote HMI of Thrissur HVDC. The balance 2 HMI s shall remain as spare at NTAMC. · Modification of HMI server configuration for enabling remote operation of RHMI from NTAMC · Procurement and deployment of the recommended hardware, software, and required licenses. · Data base configuration and engineering. · HMI mimic creation. · Supply, installation, and commissioning of HMI Client PC at NTAMC. · Configuration of WAN, DMZ, HVDC Internal firewall, and network switch es at the site level. Procurement and deployment of the recommended h ardware, software, and required licenses. · Installation & Configuration of Windows OS. · Installation & Configuration of WinCC. · Installation of cyber security software like Trend Micro and Drive lock. · Integration test for the new DC remote HMI Client. · Testing HMI client functionalities. · Testing and validation of a set of signals. · Software and License handing over to customer. · SAT report and documentation. · Establishment of running image backup of RHMI at NTAMC 5. All the necessary work as mentioned in the offer dated 14.10.2026 required for remote operation of Pugalur-Thrissur HVDC link shall be in the scope of th e contractor.

6. Carrying out required WinCC application configuration modification to enable three control locations hierarchy for Pugalur HMI’s i.e., local HMI at VSC cont rol room, LCC RHMI (located at MSB of Pugalur HVDC) & NTAMC RHMI. 7. Carrying out required WinCC application configuration modification to enable two control locations hierarchy for Thrissur HMI’s i.e., local HMI at Thrissur & NTAMC RHMI. 8. The control location shall be enabled at one location at any point of time and the HMI’s without control location shall not execute any commands/operation s from it. 9. The existing HVDC internal firewalls at Pugalur & Thrissur stations are Check point 9100 firewalls in which the configuration needs to be carried out for en abling remote HMI operation from NTAMC. 10.A commissioning format for mutually agreed test checks may be submitted by contractor for approval by POWERGRID, prior to commissioning of NTAMC RHMI for remote operation of Pugalur-Thrissur HVDC Link for approval of PO WERGRID. 11.End to end testing (From NTAMC to Pugalur and Thrissur) for remote operati on of VSC Link shall be in the scope of the contractor. 12.The vendor shall submit all the backups as applicable for provided scope of work to Custodian for revival of system in case of possible failure. 13.Accommodation & Local conveyance of service engineer of contractor shall be arranged by POWERGRID. 14.A soft ESOF button feature to be provided at the RHMI at NTAMC to carryout emergency tripping of the respective station pole similar to one deployed in HMIPC163 of Pugalur HVDC station 15.The shutdown requirement shall be kept to the minimum and shall be comm unicated to POWERGRID by contractor well in advance to obtain necessary a pprovals for the shutdown. 16.Scope completion Certificate after completion of works shall be provided by NTAMC. The same shall be submitted while submitting the bill for service por tion. 17.All the software that will be installed in RHMI at NTAMC shall have similar or perpetual license validity as provided in PK2000 project.
